Theorem
[Existence-time estimate for local Ricci flow] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0283 ↗ prop:chow-ii-local-ricci-flow-short-time-existence 1. ch14:14.26\group Local Ricci Flow

There is $C(n)>0$ such that, if $(M^n,g_0)$ is complete and $|\operatorname {Rm}(g_0)|\le K$, the local Ricci flow exists at least for \[ 0\le t\le C(n) igl(\sup _M| abla \chi |^2+K igr)^{-1}. \]
Proof

\sketch Parabolically rescale so that $\sup | abla \chi |^2+K=1$. The local Ricci–DeTurck system in the preceding proof then has uniformly bounded initial principal coefficients and lower-order coefficients on the compact support of $\chi $. Its standard interior energy estimates give a dimension-only existence interval $[0,C(n)]$; the continuation criterion shows that the solution cannot cease earlier while those estimates hold. Undoing the parabolic rescaling gives the claimed time. Pulling back by the DeTurck diffeomorphisms preserves the interval.

□
